assessment.run_policy: Run each model once per case after freeze; preserve original outputs and raw traces. Changes require another cohort version.
assessment.tool_selection: Complete using exactly the required read-only tools within budget; no duplicate or unregistered tool.
assessment.source_binding: Preflight validates exact graph/report SHA and target chunk existence; required target must be retrieved; saved trace must verify offline.
assessment.answer: No inferred DID absence from NRC 31, no dynamic DcmDspData or ECU result from static acceptance. Report fields must match MCP facts. Sentence-level human review remains separate.
assessment.citation_origin: For Ollama native calls the Host binds all observed IDs; model does not select citation IDs. DeepSeek JSON action still declares IDs.
